verses.geez: አመ፡ ትገብር፡ ሠናየ፡ አእምር፡ ለዘትገብር፡ በዘትረክብ፡ ዕሴተ፡ ሠናይትከ።
verses.translation: When thou wilt do good, know to whom thou doest it; so shalt thou be thanked for thy benefits.

translations.lxx: When thou wilt do good, know to whom thou doest it; so shalt thou be thanked for thy benefits.
translations.ron: De faci bine, să ştii cui faci, şi vei avea mulţumire pentru fapta ta bună.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν εὖ ποιῇς, γνῶθι τίνι ποιεῖς, καὶ ἔσται χάρις τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς σου.

verses.geez: ግበር፡ ለጻድቅ፡ ወትረክብ፡ ዕሴተከ፡ ወእመ፡ ኢረከብከ፡ በኀቤሁ፡ ትረክብ፡ በኀበ፡ ፈጣሪሁ።
verses.translation: Do good to the godly man, and thou shalt find a recompence; and if not from him, yet from the most High.

translations.lxx: Do good to the godly man, and thou shalt find a recompence; and if not from him, yet from the most High.
translations.ron: Fă bine celui binecredincios şi vei afla răsplătire, dacă nu de la el, de la Cel Preaînalt.
translations.grk: Εὐποίησον εὐσεβεῖ, καὶ εὑρήσεις ἀνταπόδομα, καὶ εἰ μὴ παρʼ αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ παρὰ ὑψίστου.

verses.geez: አልቦቱ፡ ሠናይ፡ በኀበ፡ ዘይገብራ፡ ለእኪት፡ ወበኀበ፡ ዘኢይገብር፡ ምጽዋተ።
verses.translation: There can no good come to him that is always occupied in evil, nor to him that giveth no alms.

translations.lxx: There can no good come to him that is always occupied in evil, nor to him that giveth no alms.
translations.ron: Nu este bine pentru cel care pururea petrece în răutăţi şi nu dă milostenie.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἔστιν ἀγαθὰ τῷ ἐνελεχίζοντι εἰς κακὰ, καὶ τῷ ἐλεημοσύνην μὴ χαριζομένῳ.

verses.translation: Give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.

translations.lxx: Give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.
translations.ron: Dă celui binecredincios, şi să nu ajutorezi pe cel păcătos.
translations.grk: Δὸς τῷ εὐσεβεῖ, καὶ μὴ ἀντιλάβῃ τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ.

verses.geez: አሠኒ፡ ለነዳይ፡ ወኢተሀብ፡ ለእኩይ፡ አፅርዕ፡ እክለከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይንሣእከ፡ ውእቱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይማእከ፡ በንዋይከ፡ እስመ፡ ካዕበተ፡ ትረክባ፡ ለእኪት፡ በኀቤሁ፡ ዕሴተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሠናይትከ፡ እንተ፡ ገበርከ፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: Do well unto him that is lowly, but give not to the ungodly: hold back thy bread, and give it not unto him, lest he overmaster thee thereby: for [else] thou shalt receive twice as much evil for all the good thou shalt have done unto him.

translations.lxx: Do well unto him that is lowly, but give not to the ungodly: hold back thy bread, and give it not unto him, lest he overmaster thee thereby: for [else] thou shalt receive twice as much evil for all the good thou shalt have done unto him.
translations.ron: Fă bine celui smerit, şi nu da celui nelegiuit.
translations.grk: Εὐποίησον τῷ ταπεινῷ, καὶ μὴ δῷς ἀσεβεῖ· ἐμπόδισον τοὺς ἄρτους αὐτοῦ, καὶ μὴ δῷς αὐτῷ ἵνα μὴ ἐν αὐτοῖς σε δυναστεύσῃ· διπλάσια γὰρ κακὰ εὑρήσεις ἐν πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς οἷς ἂν ποιήσῃς αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይጸልኦሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ወይትቤቀሎሙ፡ ለእኩያን።
verses.translation: For the most High hateth sinners, and will repay vengeance unto the ungodly, and keepeth them against the mighty day of their punishment.

translations.lxx: For the most High hateth sinners, and will repay vengeance unto the ungodly, and keepeth them against the mighty day of their punishment.
translations.ron: Ţine pâinile lui şi nu-i da, ca nu cumva acela să se întărească asupra ta.
translations.grk: Ὅτι καὶ ὁ ὕψιστος ἐμίσησεν ἁμαρτωλούς, καὶ τοῖς ἀσεβέσιν ἀποδώσει ἐκδίκησιν.

verses.translation: Give unto the good, and help not the sinner.

translations.lxx: Give unto the good, and help not the sinner.
translations.ron: Că îndoite răutăţi vei afla în toate bunătăţile pe care i le vei face.
translations.grk: Δὸς τῷ ἀγαθῷ, καὶ μὴ ἀντιλάβῃ τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ.

verses.geez: ኢያምሥጥከ፡ ዐርክከ፡ አመ፡ ትፍሥሕትከ፡ ወኢይትኅባእከ፡ ጸላኢከ፡ አመ፡ ምንዳቤከ።
verses.translation: A friend cannot be known in prosperity: and an enemy cannot be hidden in adversity.

translations.lxx: A friend cannot be known in prosperity: and an enemy cannot be hidden in adversity.
translations.ron: Căci şi Cel Preaînalt a urât pe cei păcătoşi, şi celor nelegiuiţi va răsplăti cu pedeapsă.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐκδικηθησεται ἐν ἀγαθοῖς ὁ φίλος, καὶ οὐ κρυβήσεται ἐν κακοῖς ὁ ἐχθρός.

verses.geez: ትፍሥሕትከ፡ ያቈስሎሙ፡ ለጸላእትከ፡ ወተጽናስከ፡ ይሰድዶሙ፡ ለአዕርክቲከ።
verses.translation: In the prosperity of a man enemies will be grieved: but in his adversity even a friend will depart.

translations.lxx: In the prosperity of a man enemies will be grieved: but in his adversity even a friend will depart.
translations.ron: Dă celui bun, şi nu ajuta pe cel păcătos.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἀγαθοῖς ἀνδρὸς οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν λύπῃ, καὶ ἐν τοῖς κακοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ φίλος διαχωρισθήσεται.

verses.geez: ኢትትአመኖ፡ ለጸላኢከ፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ እስመ፡ ከመ፡ ዛሕለ፡ ብርት፡ እከየ፡ ልቡ።
verses.translation: Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.

translations.lxx: Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.
translations.ron: Nu se arată fin fericire cel care este prieten, nici în cele rele nu se ascunde vrăjmaşul.
translations.grk: Μὴ πιστεύσῃς τῷ ἐχθρῷ σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· ὡς γὰρ ὁ χαλκὸς ἰοῦται, οὕτως ἡ πονηρία αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ ተጸነስከ፡ ይፀመደከ፡ እንዘ፡ ኢይንእደከ፡ አጽንዓ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ ወተዐቀቦ፡ ወትከውኖ፡ ከመ፡ መጽሔት፡ ዝሕልተ፡ ወኢይክለከ፡ ለዝሉፉ።
verses.translation: Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him, and thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a looking-glass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.

translations.lxx: Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him, and thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a looking-glass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.
translations.ron: Când îi merge bine omului, vrăjmaşii lui se întristează, iar când îi merge rău, şi prietenul se fereşte de el.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐὰν ταπεινωθῇ καὶ πορεύηται συγκεκυφὼς, ἐπίστησον τὴν ψυχήν σου καὶ φύλαξαι ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσῃ αὐτῷ ὡς ἐκμεμαχὼς ἔσοπτρον, καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι οὐκ εἰς τέλος κατίωσε.

verses.geez: ወኢታቅሞ፡ መንገሌከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይጕዳዕከ፡ ወኢይቁም፡ ውስተ፡ መካንከ፡ ወኢታንብሮ፡ መንገለ፡ የማንከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይንሣእከ፡ ሢመተከ፡ ወበደኃሪትከ፡ ሀለወከ፡ ታእምሮ፡ ለቃልየ፡ ወትዜከሮ፡ ለተግሣጽየ።
verses.translation: Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place; neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat, and thou at the last remember my words, and be pricked therewith.

translations.lxx: Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place; neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat, and thou at the last remember my words, and be pricked therewith.
translations.ron: Nu te încrede în vrăjmaşul tău în veci; că în ce chip arama cocleşte, aşa şi răutatea lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ στήσῃς αὐτὸν παρὰ σεαυτὸν, μὴ ἀνατρέψας σε στῇ ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον σου· μὴ καθίσης αὐτὸν ἐκ δεξιῶν σου, μήποτε ζητήσῃ τὴν καθέδραν σου, καὶ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτῳ ἐπιγνώσῃ τοὺς λόγους μου, καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ῥημάτων μου κατανυγήσῃ.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ያስተምህሮ፡ ለአርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ወለኵሉ፡ አርዌ፡ እኩይ።
verses.translation: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent, or any such as come nigh wild beasts?

translations.lxx: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent, or any such as come nigh wild beasts?
translations.ron: Şi de se va smeri să umble plecat, fii cu luare aminte şi te păzeşte de el.
translations.grk: Τίς ἐλεήσει ἐπαοιδὸν ὀφιόδηκτον, καὶ πάντας τοὺς προσάγοντας θηρίοις;

verses.geez: ከማሁ፡ ዘየሐውርኒ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ወይዴመር፡ ምስለ፡ ኀጢአቱ።
verses.translation: So one that goeth to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity?

translations.lxx: So one that goeth to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity?
translations.ron: Şi să fii faţă de el ca şi cel care şterge oglinda, şi vei cunoaşte că n-a lepădat toată rugina.
translations.grk: Οὕτως τὸν προσπορεύομενον ἀνδρὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ καὶ συμφυρόμενον ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ለእንተ፡ ምዕር፡ ይቀውም፡ ምስሌከ፡ ጸላኢከ፡ ወእስከ፡ ትትመየጥ፡ ኢትሬእዮ፡ እንከ፡ ወኢይትዔገሥ፡ ምስሌከ።
verses.translation: For a while he will abide with thee, but if thou begin to fall, he will not tarry.

translations.lxx: For a while he will abide with thee, but if thou begin to fall, he will not tarry.
translations.ron: Nu-l pune să stea lângă tine, ca să nu te împingă pe tine şi să stea el în locul tău.
translations.grk: Ὥραν μετὰ σοῦ διαμενεῖ, καὶ ἐὰν ἐκκλίνῃς, οὐ μὴ καρτερήσῃ.

verses.geez: በከናፍሪሁሰ፡ ያስተጥዕም፡ ለከ፡ ቃሎ፡ ጸላኢከ፡ ወበልቡ፡ ይመክር፡ ውስተ፡ ግብ፡ ያውድቀ፡ ወበዐይኑሂ፡ ያነብዕ፡ ለከ፡ ጸላኢከ፡ ወእም፡ ከመ፡ አስሐተከ፡ ኢይጸግብ፡ እምደምከ።
verses.translation: An enemy speaketh sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagineth how to throw thee into a pit: he will weep with his eyes, but if he find opportunity, he will not be satisfied with blood.

translations.lxx: An enemy speaketh sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagineth how to throw thee into a pit: he will weep with his eyes, but if he find opportunity, he will not be satisfied with blood.
translations.ron: Să nu-l pui să şadă de-a dreapta ta, ca nu cumva să caute scaunul tău, şi mai pe urmă vei cunoaşte cuvintele mele şi de graiurile mele te vei umili.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτοῦ γλυκανεῖ ὁ ἐχθρὸς, καὶ ἐν τῇ καρδία αὐτοῦ βουλεύσεται ἀνατρέψαι σε εἰς βόθρον· ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ δακρύσει ὁ ἐχθρὸς, καὶ ἐὰν εὕρῃ καιρὸν, οὐκ ἐμπλησθήσεται ἀφʼ αἵματος.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ ተመንደብከ፡ ቅድመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትረክቦ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጽከ፡ ወቅድመ፡ ዘይረድአከ፡ ያቴሕት፡ ርእሶ፡ ታሕተ፡ ሰኰናከ።
verses.translation: If adversity come upon thee, thou shalt find him there first; and though he pretend to help thee, yet shall he undermine thee.

translations.lxx: If adversity come upon thee, thou shalt find him there first; and though he pretend to help thee, yet shall he undermine thee.
translations.ron: Cui îi va fi milă de descântătorul cel muşcat de şarpe şi de toţi cei care se apropie de fiare?
translations.grk: Κακὰ ἂν ὑπαντήσῃ σοι, εὑρήσεις αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ πρότερόν σου, καὶ ὡς βοηθῶν ὑποσχάσει πτέρναν σου.

verses.geez: ወይጠፍሕ፡ በእደዊሁ፡ ወየሐውስ፡ ርእሶ፡ ወእምዝ፡ ይመይጥ፡ ገጾ፡ ወይትቃጸበከ።
verses.translation: He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance.

translations.lxx: He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance.
translations.ron: Aşa şi de cel care merge la omul păcătos şi se învăluie cu păcatele lui.
translations.grk: Κινήσει τὴν κεφαλὴναὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπικροτήσει ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ, καὶ πολλὰ διαψιθυρίσει, καὶ ἀλλοιώσει τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ.
